other_conditions: Must have supervised at least 15 full‑time Ph.D. dissertations in basic sciences or 10 in engineering/technology, with at least 5 graduates in the last 10 years
Must have a cumulative impact factor of published papers of at least 50
Must have handled at least 3 sponsored research projects funded by national/international agencies in the last 10 years
Application must be submitted within one year prior to superannuation
University must certify provision of required laboratory infrastructure, administrative assistance, and at least two Ph.D. candidates to work under the applicant
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly fellowship stipend (JRF/SRF) with contingency allowance, HRA, hostel accommodation, and leave benefits including maternity/paternity leave.
documents_required: University certification letter confirming infrastructure and candidate support
